children: U.S. home-sale prices fell for the fourth week in a row, according to Redfin. The median home-sale price was $388,613, down 0.9% year-over-year. That's four straight weeks of declines after three years of increases, handing homebuyers a bit of relief on top of what they're getting from dipping rates. Monthly housing payments dropped to a 6-week low. The median monthly mortgage payment was $2,755 at a 7.18% mortgage rate, the weekly average. Payments are down from $2,820 a month earlier. Homebuying activity held steady. Pending home sales were essentially flat from a week earlier, though they remain at the lowest level in records dating back to 2021. Dipping mortgage rates likely held off a bigger decline in pending sales. (chris.wack@wsj.com)
